completion_notes: Added module-private _ir_field, _ir_block, _n_quadrature_points helpers in taichi_printer.py routing reads from element_ir_dict (P4-5 canonical surface) with fallback to element_ir_summary. Re-routed all four legacy element_ir_summary.get(...) reads (lines ~333,334,350-352) through the helpers. New EmissionContext.verbose: bool = False gates _emit_enrichment_audit which emits stress_measure, strain_measure, tangent_rank, n_quad, force n_dof, tangent n_dof, tangent symmetric inside the file docstring when verbose AND ≥1 enrichment block populated. Default emission byte-identical to pre-P5-4 — content_hash, snapshot tests, golden files unaffected. Façade preserved; mfem/moose/_experimental/IR/lowering all untouched. Two field substitutions vs spec wording: LocalForceDescriptor.layout absent on dataclass → n_dof; MaterialEvalContract.support_tier absent → tangent_rank surfaced with defensive 'if support_tier in dict' check that auto-surfaces if added later. Conservative no-new-branches stance per task guidance — audit alone satisfies P5-4-c1; future tasks can wire material_eval.stress_measure into specific contraction emit sites if a clean branch surfaces. Gate B identified one medium (façade make_context lacks verbose kwarg — discovery-hostile) and four minor (n_dof substitution low signal, bare-tuple guard brittle, verbose field grouping ad-hoc, fixture duplication in tests). All non-blocking; user review checkpoint flagged.
